newsitem.title: UK: T&N gains as report raises bid hopes.
newsitem.headline: T&N gains as report raises bid hopes.

text.p: Shares in T&N Plc rose in pre-market trading on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times said the company could be the target of a one billion stg hostile takeover bid.
Shares in the engineering group were up 14p at 152 by 0722 GMT in volume of 128,5000 shares.
Citing unnamed industry sources, the Sunday Times said U.S. auto components groups Dana Corp and Federal Mogul Copr were said to be considering a joint bid for T&N.
It said others including BBA Group Plc might also make a bid, while GKN Plc might launch a counter bid if a rival pounced.
BBN shares were up 1/2p at 359 and GKN was down 8p at 10.50 stg.

The report also highlighted recent analyst comment on T&N that valued the company at more than 200p a share. It said T&N's shares have languished despite an expected surge in pre-tax profit this year to more than 140 million stg, up from 97 million a year before.
No-one at T&N was immediately available for comment.
